ex_lb: Ech schaffen am Bureau.

ex_lb: Muer musse mer fréi opstoen!

ex_lb: Nom Owesiesse kucken ech gären d'Tëlee.

ex_lb: Deck den Dësch, w.e.g.!
ex_en: Set the table, please!

ex_en: I'm allergic to dust.

ex_en: That book has almost 500 pages.
